+package ext
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+)
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(&rego.Function{
+		Name:        "flipt.is_auth_method",
+		Description: "Checks whether the authentication method matches a readable method name.",
+		Decl:        types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.A, types.S), types.B),
+	}, isAuthMethod)
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	methodNames := map[string]int64{
+		"token":      1,
+		"oidc":       2,
+		"kubernetes": 3,
+		"k8s":        3,
+		"github":     4,
+		"jwt":        5,
+		"cloud":      6,
+	}
+
+	name, ok := key.Value.(ast.String)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %v", key.Value)
+	}
+	expected, ok := methodNames[string(name)]
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", string(name))
+	}
+
+	obj, ok := input.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+	auth := obj.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if auth == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+	authObj, ok := auth.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+	actual := authObj.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	if actual == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	var matched bool
+	switch value := actual.Value.(type) {
+	case ast.Number:
+		matched = value.Compare(ast.Number(fmt.Sprint(expected))) == 0
+	case ast.String:
+		matched = string(value) == fmt.Sprintf("METHOD_%s", map[int64]string{1: "TOKEN", 2: "OIDC", 3: "KUBERNETES", 4: "GITHUB", 5: "JWT", 6: "CLOUD"}[expected])
+	}
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(matched), nil
+}

+package ext
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, test := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		method string
+		code   string
+		want   bool
+	}{
+		{"token", "token", "1", true},
+		{"oidc", "oidc", "2", true},
+		{"kubernetes", "kubernetes", "3", true},
+		{"k8s alias", "k8s", "3", true},
+		{"github", "github", "4", true},
+		{"jwt", "jwt", "5", true},
+		{"cloud", "cloud", "6", true},
+		{"mismatch", "token", "2", false},
+	} {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			input := ast.MustParseTerm(`{"authentication":{"method":` + test.code + `}}`)
+			method := ast.StringTerm(test.method)
+			result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, method)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(test.want), result)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	_, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.MustParseTerm(`{}`), ast.StringTerm("token"))
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")
+
+	_, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.MustParseTerm(`{"authentication":{"method":1}}`), ast.StringTerm("saml"))
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "unsupported auth method: saml")
+}
